Ensure proper control of construction materials and verify compliance with approved material submittals and technical requirements. Monitor workmanship and provide technical guidance to site engineers, supervisors, and subcontractors. Review laboratory and third-party test reports and ensure required testing is completed and compliant. Maintain accurate quality records, inspection reports, test reports, and quality documentation. Participate in mock-ups, material inspections, testing, commissioning-related inspections, and final inspections . Identify recurring quality issues and contribute to lessons learned and continuous improvement . Required Technical Knowledge Good knowledge of civil construction methods and quality control procedures . Strong knowledge of reinforced concrete, reinforcement, formwork, concrete testing, and repair methods . Knowledge of waterproofing, masonry, plastering, tiling, screed, earthworks, backfilling, and compaction . Ability to read and interpret IFC/shop drawings, specifications, material submittals, and method statements . Good knowledge of ITPs, WIR/MIR, NCRs, SORs, inspection checklists, and quality documentation . Familiarity with ACI, ASTM, and project-specific specifications . Ability to identify concrete defects , perform root cause analysis, and follow up on corrective actions. Ability to review laboratory/third-party test results and verify survey, levels, dimensions, alignment, and tolerances. Understanding of key quality risks including congested reinforcement, large concrete pours, hot-weather concreting, and construction sequencing . General Responsibilities HR Proficiency: Ability to obtain updated soft and technical skills related to the job To have a vision and a plan for the career path and how to achieve it. Compliance: Comply to related policy and procedures and work instructions. Health, Safety, and Environment: Ensure compliance of relevant safety, quality, and environmental management procedures and controls within defined area of work activity to guarantee safety, legislative compliance, and delivery of high-quality products/services.
